entities.summary: Mekhi Becton Sr., nicknamed "Big Ticket", is an American professional football guard. He played college football for the Louisville Cardinals and was selected by the New York Jets in the first round of the 2020 NFL draft. He has also played in the NFL for the Philadelphia Eagles.
